package wsagent

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/kang-sw/devenv/internal/wsdashboard"
)

// This file is compiled against the pinned pre-change tree, including its
// real Runner.Start, holdersScanned, releaseHeld and PruneRegistrations.
func TestLegacyWorkerHolderFenceAndParentDegradation(t *testing.T) {
	h, reports := newFakePiRecoveryHarness(t)
	worker, holder := spawnRecoveryWorker(t, h)
	h.runner.Close()
	h.holders.restart()
	child := h.record(worker.ID)
	now := h.opts.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
	child.HandedOffAt = now.Format(time.RFC3339)
	child.Parent = &ParentRef{Kind: ParentConversation, ReplyID: "zzparent"}
	parent := Record{ReplyID: "zzparent", Root: h.root, Backend: BackendPi, Profile: PiWorkerProfile, WSKey: "parent-key", Parent: &leadParent,
		CreatedAt: now.Format(time.RFC3339), LastActiveAt: now.Format(time.RFC3339), Sends: 1, Drained: 1,
		HeldTurn: &TurnResult{ID: "zzparent", Status: TurnDone, Message: "parent result", mark: 1}}
	for _, rec := range []Record{child, parent} {
		if err := writeRecord(wsdashboard.SessionDir(h.dir, rec.ReplyID), rec); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	h.holders.set(func() {
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"kind": "agent-worker", "backend": "pi", "reply_id": child.ReplyID, "cwd": child.workDir(), "capability": capabilityHash(child.Capability)})
		h.holders.holders[holder].session = raw
	})
	childPath := recordPath(wsdashboard.SessionDir(h.dir, child.ReplyID))
	before, err := os.ReadFile(childPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	h.start()
	wait(t, "old scan", h.runner.rejoined)
	if h.runner.conv(child.ReplyID) != nil {
		t.Fatal("old daemon started a child loop/watcher")
	}
	if st := h.state(child.ReplyID); AgentStatus(st) != AgentClosed || st.Process {
		t.Fatalf("old child projection: %+v", st)
	}
	if h.holders.opCount("launch") != 1 || h.holders.opCount("spawn") != 1 || h.holders.opCount("stop") != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("old daemon touched unrecognized holder: %v", h.holders.opList())
	}
	eventually(t, "old parent released", func() bool { rec := h.record("zzparent"); return rec.HeldTurn == nil && rec.LastTurn != nil })
	if got := reports.list(); len(got) != 1 || got[0].Result.ID != "zzparent" {
		t.Fatalf("old parent publication: %+v", got)
	}
	after, err := os.ReadFile(childPath)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(before, after) {
		t.Fatal("old daemon rewrote fenced child record")
	}
	h.runner.Close()
	// Retention ages the registration row, not the holder's living process.
	reg, err := wsdashboard.ReadRegistration(h.dir, child.ReplyID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stamp := reg.LastSeen()
	wsdashboard.PruneRegistrations(h.dir, stamp.Add(wsdashboard.RegistryRetention), wsdashboard.RegistryRetention)
	if _, err := os.Stat(childPath); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("old prune removed child at the retention boundary")
	}
	wsdashboard.PruneRegistrations(h.dir, stamp.Add(wsdashboard.RegistryRetention+time.Second), wsdashboard.RegistryRetention)
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Dir(childPath)); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatal("old prune did not remove aged fenced child directory")
	}
}

func TestLegacyWorkerHolderPiRejoinsWithoutFence(t *testing.T) {
	h, _ := newFakePiRecoveryHarness(t)
	worker, holder := spawnRecoveryWorker(t, h)
	before := h.record(worker.ID)
	if before.HandedOffAt != "" {
		t.Fatal("old fixture unexpectedly fenced Pi")
	}
	h.restart()
	wait(t, "old Pi scan", h.runner.rejoined)
	eventually(t, "old Pi replay", func() bool {
		c := h.runner.conv(worker.ID)
		done := false
		c.do(func() { done = !c.replaying })
		return done
	})
	after := h.record(worker.ID)
	if after.HolderID != holder || after.HostPID != before.HostPID || !after.TurnOpen {
		t.Fatal("legacy Pi identity changed")
	}
	if h.holders.opCount("launch") != 1 || h.holders.opCount("spawn") != 1 || h.holders.opCount("stop") != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("old Pi duplicate/stop: %v", h.holders.opList())
	}
}
